versions.changelog:
Initial release – combine multiple MP3 files into a video playlist with customizable visual effects.

- Concatenate all MP3 files from a folder into a single MP4 video with optional black background or menu overlay.
- Menu overlay video supports displaying the full tracklist, current track highlight, and animated vinyl disc effects.
- Includes automatic dependency checks (ffmpeg, ffprobe, Python), input order validation, and output file/media stream verification.
- Supports performance optimization via smart segment rendering: high frame density at track switches, single static frames for inactive segments, and parallel processing for faster menu video generation.
- Flexible command-line options for input/output paths, rendering modes, vinyl sizing/position, and preview frame extraction.
- Suitable for playlist merging, batch MP3-to-video conversion, playlist-to-video, animated menus, and music compilation videos.
